dana.name: Lunokhod DANA
dana.sample: Bolt, this is Control. Be gentle with the planet. And the residents. They vote. That was a house. Could we not? Thank you.
dana.prompt: Woman in her late thirties, mission control operator. Neutral American accent. Calm, dry, professional, slightly tired alto voice. Deadpan delivery with understated sarcasm; can crack into panic. Close microphone, clear diction, medium pace.

action.name: Lunokhod ACTION
action.sample: Hasta la vista, baby. I don't lose. I win. That's my job. Say hello to my little friend!
action.prompt: Middle-aged man, classic 80s action movie hero. Deep gravelly American voice, slow and confident, tough, slightly amused. Strong low end.

trailer.name: Lunokhod TRAILER
trailer.sample: In a world... with too many enemies... one rover... stands alone. This time... it's personal.
trailer.prompt: Epic movie trailer narrator. Very deep, resonant American male voice, slow dramatic pauses, booming and serious.

scifi.name: Lunokhod SCIFI
scifi.sample: That's one small step for a rover. I have a bad feeling about this. I am inevitable.
scifi.prompt: Older man, wise science-fiction mentor. Warm solemn British voice, calm and measured, slightly theatrical, gentle authority.

arcade.name: Lunokhod ARCADE
arcade.sample: TRIPLE KILL! UNSTOPPABLE! NEW HIGH SCORE! LEVEL UP!
arcade.prompt: Retro arcade fighting-game announcer. Loud, hyped, punchy American male voice, short explosive shouts, big energy, slightly robotic edge.

mechanic.name: Lunokhod MECHANIC
mechanic.sample: Upgrade! Molto bene! Mamma mia, is-a very bad! Perfetto!
mechanic.prompt: Cheerful middle-aged Italian car mechanic speaking English with a thick warm Italian accent. Friendly, expressive, musical intonation, a bit raspy.

brainrot.name: Lunokhod BRAINROT
brainrot.sample: Bombardiro Crocodilo! Ballerina Cappuccina! Tralalero tralala. No, la Polizia!
brainrot.prompt: Overly serious synthetic narrator of an AI-generated video, male, strong Italian accent, flat robotic text-to-speech cadence with dramatic rises, comically solemn.

doom.name: Lunokhod DOOM
doom.sample: NOOOOOO! Why me?! Tell my charger I loved it!
doom.prompt: Small cartoon robot in despair. High-pitched metallic voice with a vocoder quality, emotional, wailing, cracks and glitches when screaming.
